Settings.alleinerziehendKinder: Single parent: number of children under 18

Banking.title: Bank statement import
Banking.subtitle: Upload your bank statements as CSV — the format is auto-detected, income is matched with invoices, expenses are categorized by AI.
Banking.csvAllBanksHint: Auto-detected: N26 · Sparkasse · DKB · ING · Commerzbank · Volksbank · generic SEPA. Just upload the online-banking export — we do the rest.
Banking.afterImport1: Incoming payments are matched to open invoices automatically (via reference text)
Banking.afterImport2: Expenses are classified by AI (business / personal + SKR03 category)
Banking.afterImport3: At ≥ 80 % confidence → automatically saved as a business expense
Banking.afterImport4: You can correct anything → the rule is stored for next time
Banking.noStatementHint: Press “Import CSV” at the top. Step-by-step CSV-export instructions for every supported bank are inside the dialog.
Banking.dialogDescription: Upload the CSV file from your online banking. We detect the format automatically and match payments with your invoices.
Banking.supportedFormatsList: N26 · Sparkasse (CAMT) · DKB · ING-DiBa · Commerzbank · Volksbank/Raiffeisen · generic SEPA
Banking.whereCsvExportTitle: 💡 Where do I find the CSV export?
Banking.whereCsvN26: N26: app → transactions → filter → 3-dot menu → export
Banking.whereCsvSparkasse: Sparkasse: online banking → transactions → export → CSV-CAMT
Banking.whereCsvDkb: DKB: financial status → transactions → export → CSV
Banking.noTxYet: No transactions yet. Connect your bank and press Sync.
Banking.pdfDropZone: Drop your bank statement here or click to choose
Banking.pdfPreviewHint: Review the transactions and adjust them if needed before importing.
Banking.pdfErrorMissingKey: ANTHROPIC_API_KEY missing — please set it in .env.local and restart the server.
Banking.pdfErrorTooShort: PDF has no extractable text (likely a scanned document). OCR fallback will follow in a later version.
Banking.pdfErrorParseFailed: AI could not understand the PDF. Try a different statement or use CSV import.
Banking.pdfDialogDescription: Upload a PDF bank statement — Faktivo-AI will extract the transactions automatically and link them to your account.
Banking.bulkPdfHint: Drag up to 50 PDFs here — we process them in parallel.
Banking.bulkPdfMaxFiles: Up to 50 PDFs · max 5 MB each
Banking.learnHint: Faktivo will remember this for the next import.
Banking.materializeAllHint: Uses the AI suggestions — you can change categories later.
Banking.detectTransfersHint: Finds matching account-to-account moves and removes double-booked income/expense entries.
Banking.detectTransfersToast: {pairs} transfer pair(s) detected, {legs} row(s) cleaned up.
Banking.accountsSubtitle: All your bank accounts and cards in one overview.
Banking.accountsEmptyHint: Import your first bank statement — we'll detect the account automatically.

Jobcenter.title: Jobcenter monthly report
Jobcenter.subtitle: Income-surplus calculation per Anlage EKS — {month}
Jobcenter.infoTitle: This calculation follows the logic of Anlage EKS (self-employment income under Bürgergeld).
Jobcenter.infoBody: Only income and expenses marked as “Jobcenter-relevant” are included in the balance.
Jobcenter.rechnerSubtitle: §11b SGB II + §3 ALG II-V — automatic calculation of allowance, attribution and difference between provisional and final.
Jobcenter.noBwz: No approval period stored. Enter start/end in <link>Settings</link> to enable the clawback calculator.
Jobcenter.saldoExplainRueck: → You will have to repay this amount to the Jobcenter, because your actual income exceeded the forecast.
Jobcenter.saldoExplainNach: → The Jobcenter will pay this amount back to you, because your actual income was below the forecast.
Jobcenter.saldoExplainBalanced: → Forecast and actuals match, no clawback.
Jobcenter.deductibleExpensesHint: {count, plural, one {# entry} other {# entries}} · Jobcenter-relevant only
Jobcenter.saldoHint: Basis for attribution by the Jobcenter
Jobcenter.noDeductibleInRange: No relevant expenses in this period.
Jobcenter.footerNote: Note: the official EKS form will be exported as PDF in a later version (phase 2). For ELSTER submission you currently have to transfer the values manually.
Jobcenter.subtitleRange: Income-surplus calculation per Anlage EKS — Period: {range}
Jobcenter.rangePickerHint: Pick the approval period (Bewilligungszeitraum) or any custom range. The numbers below and the PDF update accordingly.
Jobcenter.monthlyBreakdownHint: Per month: income − deductible expenses = surplus. §11b SGB II allowance applied individually each month.
Jobcenter.verifyHint: Bürgergeld credits do NOT count as self-employment income — shown here only as a plausibility check.
Jobcenter.methodologyHint: Calculation per month: Jobcenter-relevant self-employment income minus Jobcenter-relevant deductible business expenses. §11b SGB II allowance applied per month: €100 basic + 20% on 100–1,000 € + 10% on 1,000–1,200 € (up to 1,500 € with minor child). Countable = max(0, surplus − allowance).
Jobcenter.vorlaeufigHint: Expected income per month for the upcoming approval period.
Jobcenter.vorlaeufigNoMonths: Please choose a valid approval period (start before end).
Jobcenter.vorlaeufigThresholdWarn: Average is above €1,000 — Tier 2 offsetting may apply, please check.
Jobcenter.comparisonHint: Difference between forecast and actual income — basis for refund/payback.
Jobcenter.rueckforderungExplain: You owe the Jobcenter {amount} because your actual income was above the forecast.
Jobcenter.nachzahlungExplain: The Jobcenter will pay you {amount} because your actual income was below the forecast.
Jobcenter.comparisonBalancedExplain: Forecast and actual income match — no refund or back-payment.
Jobcenter.comparisonNoBwz: No approval period set. Add start/end in settings.
Jobcenter.comparisonNoBedarf: Monthly need not set — please enter the amount so refund/back-payment can be calculated.
Jobcenter.comparisonMinorChildrenYes: With minor child in household (Tier 2 cap €1,500)
Jobcenter.comparisonMethodology: Calculation per §41a SGB II: payment = max(0, need − countable). Per-month difference between preliminary and final payment, summed = refund (positive) or back-payment (negative).
Jobcenter.buergergeldNudgeTitle: {count, plural, one {# Bürgergeld payment} other {# Bürgergeld payments}} not yet recorded
Jobcenter.buergergeldNudgeHint: Banking detected {amount} in Jobcenter benefits but they aren't recorded for EKS verification yet. One-click backfill.
Jobcenter.documentsHint: Upload Bewilligungsbescheid, WBA or an already-submitted EKS — Faktivo-AI extracts the values and pre-fills your settings.
Jobcenter.dropZone: Drop your document here (PDF, JPG, PNG, max 10 MB)
Jobcenter.dropZoneHint: Or click to choose — Faktivo-AI will extract the fields
Jobcenter.bwzMismatchWarning: The detected approval period ({docBwz}) differs from your current one ({currentBwz}). Is this a new WBA?
Jobcenter.smartFillHint: After applying, we'll open the preliminary EKS form with values from your banking history.
Jobcenter.noMonthsExtracted: No months detected — please add manually.
Jobcenter.errKeyMissing: AI service not configured — API key missing.
Jobcenter.errWrongMime: File format not supported. Allowed: PDF, JPG, PNG, WEBP, HEIC.
Jobcenter.errParseFailed: AI could not read the document. Try a clearer photo or original PDF.
Jobcenter.errVisionRateLimit: AI rate limit reached — please retry in a few seconds.
